results.title: Shush
results.overview: A bookstore employee faces off with a silent stalker on Halloween night.

results.title: Gaspi: Camino a la Velada
results.overview: Gaspi flees the city, but he cannot escape his destiny. He agrees to take part in a boxing match solely for the money, placing himself at the mercy of his new trainer, Sergio Bara. Together, they will experience moments that are funny, bizarre, and dreamlike, guided by a single motto: “Hit… and don’t get hit.”

results.title: Bombarded by Corruption
results.overview: In 45 minutes, the documentary explores the circumstances surrounding the 1995 attack on the Río Tercero Military Factory, focusing on the causes and the context of the tragedy. Río Tercero natives Fernando Colautti, Guillermo Vigliecca, and Francisco Carranza are the filmmakers behind this production, which combines a journalistic tone with a cinematic format. Marking the 30th anniversary of the Río Tercero explosions, the film addresses the question of "why it happened." The project is supported by the National University of Río Tercero (UNRT); the legislation establishing the university was primarily driven by the goal of providing historical reparation to the city following that state-sponsored crime.

results.title: Just Thoughts
results.overview: A man who, isolated in a nearly deserted city, enters a space where his body and mind begin to fracture. Amidst distorted memories and heavy silences, he confronts a pain he has avoided for too long. A fly, seemingly watching him with unsettling persistence, acts as a witness to the darkest corners of his inner self.

results.title: In the Valleys
results.overview: After leaving their young daughter home alone in the middle of the night, a couple finds themselves caught up in inexplicable phenomena upon hearing a radio report about lights in the sky invading the valleys.

results.title: Saint & the Sea
results.overview: As a storm approaches their coastal village, a fisherman’s family prepares for the departure of their 14-year-old daughter.

results.title: Lippenstift
results.overview: Tomorrow is the funeral of Benedicte’s stepfather. She is 43, a psychologist, and a mother. She has to deal with her children’s anxieties about what to wear, see her patients before leaving, prepare sandwiches for the trip, and put up with her husband’s sarcasm. So far, she’s holding it together.

results.title: Mr. Wonderful
results.overview: A deep dive into the world of Luiz de Freitas (better known as Mr. Wonderful), Brazil’s first Black fashion designer. Born in Pau Grande, in the interior of Rio de Janeiro state, he defied conventions and revolutionized Brazilian menswear with his unique personality, his brand, and his fashion shows.

results.title: 3 Lambs
results.overview: In a post-graduation landscape of boredom, uncertainty, and struggle, there is a desire for the simpler life: a shepherd and artist in the middle of the rural South.

results.title: The Substitute
results.overview: In the midst of Carnival, taxi driver Manoel finds a sex toy in his living room. Huge and still sticky, the object sets off a tragicomic journey that shakes his imagination and challenges his sense of masculinity.

results.title: The Bryce Lee Story
results.overview: When thirteen-year-old Bryce Lee claims to be related to martial arts legend Bruce Lee to gain respect at school, the falsehood threatens to unravel his identity, his friendships, and his self-worth.

results.title: Anumägi
results.overview: A young peasant girl in old Estonia is torn between religion and ancient custom in the aftermath of a traumatic event.

results.title: I Went to Check On You Sleep
results.overview: Thirty-five years in the life of a couple, told through 2,000 notes and family photographs. Love, jealousy, pain, resilience, and death, reflected upon by Aldir Blanc, the creator of some of the most beautiful lyrics in Brazilian popular music — including “O Bêbado e a Equilibrista” (“The Drunkard and the Tightrope Walker”), written for his wife, Mari Lúcia.  Six years after Aldir’s death, the notes continue to emerge, hidden inside objects throughout the couple’s apartment in Rio de Janeiro’s Tijuca neighborhood. Mari revisits forgotten moments and opens the moving treasure trove of notes in the year Aldir — who died of COVID-19 in 2020 — would have turned 80.

results.title: Click Clack, Front & Caps
results.overview: On the drive home from a night-long hotel party, Eve finally gets a moment alone with the crush she’s kept secret for years, her brother’s best mate, and shoots her shot.

results.title: The Last Delivery
results.overview: This is the story of two greedy friends who, driven by greed, murder a delivery boy.

results.title: Zeitgeist
results.overview: Five friends get together to make live videos in hopes of going viral and making money, but when it doesn't work, they decide to take a more extreme path, unleashing a power game led by the chat.

results.title: Hope - A "Just Another Society" Story
results.overview: The story of Friar Elia and the Boy continues. In this new look at modern society, we will see two lives face the difficulties of their journeys. ONLY ON YOUTUBE
